name: trellis
description: Chrome extension that keeps sensitive data out of AI chatbots

scripts.check: node scripts/check-encoding.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))" && for f in *.js test/*.js test/e2e/*.js test/firefox/*.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.package: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/package.js
scripts.package:firefox: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/package.js --target=firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
